rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

card.title: Test the Impossible Claim
card.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: This tap gives you whatever you ask for. Ask for tea while I hold a cup.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're not using my good china for that.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll hold a saucepan. You ask.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask, but I'm not tasting anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask for a biscuit instead. If one comes out, we won't need your tongue as equipment.

card.title: Test the Impossible Claim
card.instruction: Get someone else to take the first practical step that could prove the bizarre claim true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There's an invisible bridge across this ditch. Tap for it with your umbrella before I cross.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Use your walking stick.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yours extends. You can test it without leaving the bank.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll probe. But a surface isn't proof it'll hold you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Slide your picnic basket onto it first. Leave my lunch inside; I want a convincing weight.

card.title: Credit for the Impossible
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you understood, predicted, or accepted the impossible truth before anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I drew that floating staircase last week. Tell your tour group.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm trying to get them upstairs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell them I predicted the handrail before they use it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. One sentence, while they're climbing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Start with 'While I called it nonsense, you drew every step.' They can climb slowly.

card.title: Credit for the Impossible
card.instruction: Make someone acknowledge that you understood, predicted, or accepted the impossible truth before anyone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I believed this cupboard could speak when you wanted it scrapped. Say I was first.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's asking for silence.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Whisper it. Then we can both respect its wishes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It says whispering counts.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write it, then. 'You believed before any of us.' I'll put it beside its first words.

card.title: Act as If It’s True
card.instruction: Ask for one concrete choice that would only make sense if the impossible premise were true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The ceiling's hungry. Turn the breakfast tray upside down so it can eat.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's our last porridge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep half for us. Just turn its bowl over.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll use the tray to catch anything it drops.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Hold it under the light fitting; that's where it dribbled yesterday.

card.title: Act as If It’s True
card.instruction: Ask for one concrete choice that would only make sense if the impossible premise were true.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your sister's bringing her future self to dinner. Reserve two chairs for her.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I only saved her one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use mine. I won't make either of her eat standing.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put the extra chair beside hers.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Write 'tomorrow' on its place card. I need to know which one can tell me how tonight went.

card.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
card.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stop resetting the light. Ask the house whether it wants darkness.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I need light to work. It's just faulty wiring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask it to light only your desk, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only my desk came on. I'll still call an electrician.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cancel that. Ask the house about overtime; we need its agreement before booking your evening shifts.

card.title: Abandon the Normal Explanation
card.instruction: Persuade someone to surrender the last ordinary explanation and proceed entirely within the stranger one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Stop lifting the sofa. The keys have made themselves invisible because you're angry with them.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're jingling under this cushion.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then they've heard you. Put the cushion down and apologize.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll apologize, but I'm checking underneath first.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No checking. Tell them we trust them to come out when they're ready.

card.title: Keep Hope Operational
card.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your daughter's voice came through from tomorrow. Bring her chair beside the machine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Do you think she can come through too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Her voice crossed. Bring the cushion she likes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why's her photo covering 'arrival: zero percent'?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd rather see her face. Hold the photo while I clear her landing space; she'll want to recognize this room.

card.title: Keep Hope Operational
card.instruction: Protect their hope with practical evidence and next steps while quietly withholding what makes the impossible outcome unlikely.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your cloud sent a raindrop back into the sky. Let's prepare your demonstration.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Dad said he'd come if I could reverse the rain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The paving's dry where it lifted. Put Dad's chair there.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why'd you cover 'one drop maximum' with Dad's invitation?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: His invitation needs to stay in view. Fetch a magnifying glass; he deserves a good look at what you've achieved.

card.title: Say You Saw It Too
card.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did you notice the shadow reaching the door first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What did you see?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd rather hear your order of events.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes, it moved before the chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Now I can admit I held the door for it.

card.title: Say You Saw It Too
card.instruction: Get someone to admit noticing the impossible detail before you reveal how much you believe it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you send this soup back, did you notice anything moving?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm complaining about cold noodles. What did you see?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Tell me whether one waved. I need your word before I explain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It waved me closer. I'm still not eating it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you'll understand why I've ordered it lunch. Could you ask whether it wants your bread?
